acceptance: The shell renders a project list and can create, select, and open a session-only project without implying durable persistence.
The workspace exposes a primary layout, activity/event panel, explicit preview placeholder, and command/change-intent entry.
Shell activity uses canonical protocol EventRecord validation and does not introduce parallel run/event identifiers.
Command entry records intent/activity only and makes no generation, execution, save, or deployment claim.
A production Next.js standalone build succeeds and an HTTP smoke observes the expected shell marker.
Focused shell-state tests plus exact-head Ubuntu/Windows repository CI pass.

required: Focused shell-state/project/activity tests including non-persistence and no-fake-generation fixtures.
Production Next.js standalone build plus real HTTP shell-marker smoke.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Create one qualified control-plane package and reuse existing protocol contracts; defer persistence and full design-system work to their dependency-ordered Grains.

requirements: Session-only state must be labeled as non-persistent in the user surface and evidence.
The command entry must not simulate model execution, code generation, file writes, deployment, or acceptance.
No provider-specific deployment or Vercel-only API may become required.

outcome: The qualified Next.js control plane exposes a truthful session-only project/workspace shell with project list/create/open, workspace layout, activity/events, preview placeholder, and bounded change-intent entry.
rationale: Canonical P01-S03-T01 frontier after SG-000011 completion.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000012, the control-plane shell package, workspace lockfile changes, docs, and evidence; no persistent backend or external side effect is authorized.

scope_in: Create the real Ineractive control-plane Next.js App Router package using the canonically qualified Next.js 16.3.5 / React 19.3.0 baseline.
Implement project list plus session-only create/open project behavior with an explicit non-persistence boundary.
Implement the primary workspace layout with project navigation, workspace header, central preview placeholder, and activity/event panel.
Implement a command/change-intent entry that records local shell activity without claiming model execution or source mutation.
Reuse the public SG-000010/SG-000011 protocol identities and Event records for shell activity rather than inventing parallel run/event types.
Provide deterministic shell-state tests and a real production Next.js build/smoke path.
scope_out: No Supabase persistence, auth, user/project membership, or generated-application data plane; those remain IN-P01-S05-T01.
No final tokenized brand/design system; that remains IN-P01-S04-T01.
No Product Graph, model call, code generation, filesystem mutation, runtime capability grant, or deployment.
